Advanced Construct (CC).name: Advanced Construct (CC)
Advanced Construct (CC).description:
To advance a prototype construct companion to an advanced construct companion (usually a result of one of tu class feat choices), make the following adjustments.

  • Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
  • Increase its ataque sin armas daño from one die to two dice (for instance, 1d8 to 2d8).
  • Increase its proficiency rank for Perception and all tiradas de salvación to expert.
  • Increase its proficiency ranks in Intimidation, Stealth, and Survival to entrenado. If the construct is tu innovation and it was already entrenado in those skills from a modification, increase its proficiency rank in those skills to expert.
  • Puedes change tu companion's Size, if you want, to either Small, Medium, or Large.

Incredible Construct (CC).name: Incredible Construct (CC)
Incredible Construct (CC).description:
To improve an advanced construct companion to an incredible construct companion, make the following adjustments.

  • Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution and Wisdom modifiers by 2.
  • It deals 2 daño adicional with its ataques sin armas. Its attacks become magical, allowing it to bypass resistances to non-magical attacks.
  • Increase its proficiency ranks in Athletics and Acrobatics to expert.

Megaton Strike (CC).name: Megaton Golpe (CC)
Megaton Strike (CC).description:
Activas gears, explosives, and other hidden mechanisms in tu innovation to make a powerful attack. Tú make a Golpe, dealing an extra die of daño del arma. If estás at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if estás at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice. The type of Golpe puedes make depends on tu innovation.

  • Armor Tú Golpe with a melee ataque sin armas or a melee arma. To use a melee arma for this, debes have prepared it in advance with special contraptions when you make tu daily preparations.
  • Construct Tu minion innovation Golpes.
  • Weapon Tú Golpe with tu arma innovation.

Unstable Function Tú put even more force into the Golpe, though you risk stress fractures to tu innovation. Add the unstable rasgo to Megaton Golpe. The Golpe deals another extra dado de daño, for a total of two extra dice at 4th level, three at 10th level, and four at 18th level.

Special If tu innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.

Paragon Construct (CC).name: Paragon Construct (CC)
Paragon Construct (CC).description:
To improve an incredible construct companion to a paragon construct companion, make the following adjustments.

  • Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
  • Increase its proficiency rank for ataques sin armas and unarmored defense to expert.
  • Increase its proficiency ranks for Athletics, Acrobatics, tiradas de salvación, and Perception to master.
  • Increase its ataque sin armas daño from two dice to three dice, and its daño adicional with ataques sin armas from 2 to 4.

Unarmed Strike 1.name: Unarmed Golpe 1
Unarmed Strike 1.description: Rename this feat to rename the strike created by it, the image of this feat can also be adjusted to the image you want for the strike.
